resources.name: Customer
resources.doc: A business that buys from Acme. Not the tenant.

resources.name: Department
resources.doc:
Organizational units under a customer form a tree; moving a node never
changes its identity.

resources.name: OrderDocument
resources.doc: Documents attached to an order: quotes, signed contracts, proof of delivery.

resources.name: SitePolicy
resources.doc:
Per-site operating policy, effective-dated: at most one policy per site
applies at any instant; intervals are half-open [from, until).

views.name: PendingOrders
views.doc: Orders awaiting approval for a customer: a logical read-only query.

caches.name: CurrentSitePolicy
caches.doc:
Current policy for a site: a reader with a hard freshness bound tied to
the next effective boundary (plan §16).

workflows.name: ProcessOrder
workflows.doc:
Durable order processing (plan §15): submit, wait for the payment capture
correlated by reference, approve, then fan out bounded follow-ups.

definition.Comment: Forge workflow driver for @acme/commerce/_/ProcessOrder; all step semantics live in the portable executor.

classification.business: declared domain errors: served, counted separately
classification.counting: one event per logical operation; retries are attempts on the same event, never new events
